content.text:
===
plugins {
    id("io.swcode.urbo.build.logic.application")
}

dependencies {
    implementation(platform(urbocatalog.urbo.platform))

    implementation(project(":erlebnis-stadt-experience"))
    implementation(project(":menden-experience-adapter"))
    implementation(project(":menden-client"))

    implementation(urbocatalog.urbo.casbin)
    implementation(urbocatalog.urbo.core.starter)
    implementation(urbocatalog.urbo.command)
    implementation(urbocatalog.urbo.notification.sendinblue)
    implementation(urbocatalog.urbo.notification.subscription)

    implementation(urbocatalog.spring.boot)
    implementation(urbocatalog.spring.boot.autoconfigure)

    testImplementation(urbocatalog.spring.boot.starter.test)
    testImplementation(urbocatalog.urbo.test.support)
    // erlebnis-stadt-experience declares this as `implementation`, so its supertypes
    // (JpaRepository, JpaSpecificationExecutor) are not on this module's test compile
    // classpath by default — needed to persist a fixture event via ExperienceEventRepository.
    testImplementation(urbocatalog.spring.boot.starter.data.jpa)
}
===
distributionBase=GRADLE_USER_HOME
distributionPath=wrapper/dists
distributionUrl=https\://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-9.7.1-bin.zip
networkTimeout=10000
retries=0
retryBackOffMs=500
validateDistributionUrl=true
zipStoreBase=GRADLE_USER_HOME
zipStorePath=wrapper/dists

observation.command: grep -rn "jvmToolchain\|JavaLanguageVersion\|languageVersion" /workspace/backend --include="*.kts" | head; echo ===; cat /workspace/backend/menden-app/build.gradle.kts | head -50; echo ===; cat /workspace/backend/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties
